Working / idle counts come from fresh worker observations; model processes are measured separately in worker process trees. Shared Docker capacity and idle pollers are counted once per fleet; problem rows show only matched issue jobs. Missing or stale process measurements are unknown; incomplete coverage is marked partial. An idle poller is waiting for ready work, not a stopped experiment. Model processes may include nested sessions and are not a count of solved problems. Accepted proofs have passed the isolated workflow gates; an author-run comparator pass alone is not acceptance. Parents compose accepted dependencies. Only root solutions integrate into the target branch. Child PRs close unmerged as linked review records after root delivery; their PR state is separate from proof acceptance.
